referenceHost.topology: isolated single-host Compose, sequential fault stages, two API replicas for quota tests

invariants: No duplicate charge, refund, reservation, transfer or durable history identity
No foreign-tenant delivery or ownership changes
No acknowledged provider callback without a durable inbox row
Pending work and DLQ entries survive restart and restore
Rollbacks reuse verified digests and never reverse database migrations
policy: A failed objective is a failed acceptance result with a recorded remediation; missing stages and samples fail.
